title: Protective effects of Rosa canina fruit extract against kidney damage induced by CCl4.
authors: Gazwi, Hanaa S S; Ragab, Amany E; Soltan, Osama I A; Abdein, Mohamed A; Shakoor, Bushra; Shafiq, Nusrat; Refaat, Inas Hussein; Al-Rejaie, Salim S; Djurasevic, Sinisa; Mohany, Mohamed; Zaki, Asmaa H
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蔷薇果提取物对CCl4肾损伤的保护作用，分子对接仅涉及HO-1与Nrf2蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The study explored the nephroprotective potential of Rosa canina (dog rose) ethanolic fruit extract against carbon tetrachloride (CCl4)-induced nephrotoxicity in rats, while also analyzing its phytochemical composition using UPLC-ESI-MS/MS. Male Wistar rats were allocated into five groups: control, R. canina extract alone, CCl4-induced nephrotoxicity, CCl4 with R. canina extract and CCl4 with silymarin. UPLC-ESI-MS/MS revealed 15 compounds in R. canina extract, predominantly anthocyanins, flavonoids, and lycopene. Treatment with R. canina extract significantly ameliorated CCl4-induced kidney dysfunction, abating oxidative stress and inflammation. Enhanced expression of HO-1 (heme oxygenase-1) and Nrf2 (nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2) mRNA in the kidney suggested their involvement in protective mechanisms. Inhibition of HO-1 attenuated R. canina's protective effect against CCl4-induced kidney injury, underscoring the significance of the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway. For further validation, high throughput molecular docking analysis were performed. The docking analysis revealed the interaction between HO-1 and Nrf2 against Pelarginidin, Malvidin and Petunidin. Among all the three compounds, pelargonidin showed the highest binding score of -9.3 kcal/mol and -7.7 kcal/mol against Nrf2 and HO-1 respectively. In conclusion, R. canina extract, rich in phenolics, exhibited nephroprotective effects via inflammation and oxidative stress attenuation, potentially mediated through Nrf2/HO-1 pathway modulation against CCl4-induced nephrotoxicity.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了犬蔷薇（Rosa canina）乙醇果实提取物对大鼠四氯化碳（CCl4）诱导肾毒性的肾脏保护潜力，同时利用UPLC-ESI-MS/MS分析其植物化学成分。雄性Wistar大鼠被分为五组：对照组、单独给予犬蔷薇提取物组、CCl4诱导肾毒性组、CCl4联合犬蔷薇提取物组以及CCl4联合水飞蓟素组。UPLC-ESI-MS/MS在犬蔷薇提取物中鉴定出15种化合物，主要为花青素、黄酮类和番茄红素。犬蔷薇提取物处理显著改善了CCl4诱导的肾功能障碍，减轻了氧化应激和炎症。肾脏中HO-1（血红素加氧酶-1）和Nrf2（核因子E2相关因子2）mRNA表达增强，提示其参与保护机制。抑制HO-1减弱了犬蔷薇提取物对CCl4诱导肾损伤的保护作用，强调了Nrf2/HO-1通路的重要性。为进一步验证，进行了高通量分子对接分析。对接分析揭示了HO-1和Nrf2与天竺葵素、锦葵素和矮牵牛素之间的相互作用。在这三种化合物中，天竺葵素对Nrf2和HO-1的对接得分最高，分别为-9.3 kcal/mol和-7.7 kcal/mol。总之，富含酚类化合物的犬蔷薇提取物通过减轻炎症和氧化应激表现出肾脏保护作用，其机制可能涉及通过调节Nrf2/HO-1通路对抗CCl4诱导的肾毒性。
